verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as bulk exporting, moving, tagging or deleting many meetings at once, are a fair capability to ask of a meeting-notes SaaS. The evidence documents no such product feature. Cross-meeting search and analysis through MCP or AI Chat, per-meeting automatic syncs to S3, Airtable and Drive, auto-join scheduling, and a read-only Public API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
